channel.title: Pier & Point · Radiance
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Radiance (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Radiance: The only architect named in a source read is John Perkins Sr., Perkins &…
item.description: The only architect named in a source read is John Perkins Sr., Perkins & Co., in a 2009 San Francisco Chronicle article; no second source confirms it. For the later 435 China Basin tower, DBI's data gives both 319 units (original permit) and 329 units (a 2014 permit correcting the count). Source: https://www.sfgate.com/realestate/article/Radiance-offers-first-homes-in-Mission-Bay-3247162.php ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201205170704.

item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.description: Radiance now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8720018.

item.title: Correction · Radiance: Radiance's March 22, 2009 SFGate article is a report that the homes were on…
item.description: Radiance's March 22, 2009 SFGate article is a report that the homes were on offer, so the timeline no longer treats it as the completion. The Assessor gives 2008 as year built and the city's permit was signed off complete on January 19, 2010. Press says 99 homes and the permit says 98. Source: SFGate, 2009-03-22 (sfgate.com/realestate/article/Radiance-offers-first-homes-in-Mission-Bay-3247162.php); DBI permit 200505112126 (data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200505112126).

item.title: Correction · Radiance: The map notes said Radiance is 9 stories per two realtor sources
item.description: The map notes said Radiance is 9 stories per two realtor sources; of the readable sources, SFGate describes a nine-story and a six-story building and OSM has 8 levels, so the notes were rewritten. The 'first homes' milestone moved from September 2008 to March 2009, the date of the SFGate article that reports it, and the December 2006 groundbreaking milestone was removed because no readable source dates it. The OSM tag citation was corrected to name=. Source: SFGate, 2009-03-22 (https://www.sfgate.com/realestate/article/Radiance-offers-first-homes-in-Mission-Bay-3247162.php); OpenStreetMap way 1258086102 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1258086102); Bosa Development, Radiance and Madrone, Mission Bay (https://bosadevelopment.com/project/radiance-madrone-mission-bay/).
item.source: SFGate, 2009-03-22 (https://www.sfgate.com/realestate/article/Radiance-offers-first-homes-in-Mission-Bay-3247162.php); OpenStreetMap way 1258086102 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1258086102); Bosa Development, Radiance and Madrone, Mission Bay (https://bosadevelopment.com/project/radiance-madrone-mission-bay/)

item.title: Milestone · Radiance: DBI records the new-construction permit complete (final… (Jan 19, 2010)
item.description: DBI records the new-construction permit complete (final sign-off); later than the Assessor's 2008 year built, so it does not date occupancy (Jan 19, 2010). Source: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection.
item.source: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection

item.title: Milestone · Radiance: Radiance (325 China Basin St) described as offering its first… (~Mar 2009)
item.description: Radiance (325 China Basin St) described as offering its first homes in a March 22, 2009 SFGate/Chronicle article ('Radiance offers first homes in Mission Bay'); a sales report by publication date, not a completion or occupancy date (DBI recorded the permit complete on 2010-01-19). Bosa's project page calls it the first major condominium development in the United States after the 2008 market downturn (~Mar 2009). Source: https://www.sfgate.com/realestate/article/Radiance-offers-first-homes-in-Mission-Bay-3247162.php; https://bosadevelopment.com/project/radiance-madrone-mission-bay/.

item.title: Complete · Radiance: Completed: the Assessor's 2022 roll gives 2008 as year built for the… (~2008)
item.description: Completed: the Assessor's 2022 roll gives 2008 as year built for the 99 unit parcels on block 8720 that carry that year (the count matches the 99-unit figure in the press and architecture-database sources); the Chronicle's March 22, 2009 article already describes Radiance Phase One as built, with model homes (~2008). Source: DataSF / San Francisco Office of the Assessor-Recorder; San Francisco Chronicle via SFGate (Judy Richter), 2009-03-22.
item.source: DataSF / San Francisco Office of the Assessor-Recorder; San Francisco Chronicle via SFGate (Judy Richter), 2009-03-22
